test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

7, 13, 27, 53, 107, ?
solution:
Given, 

7, 13, 27, 53, 107, ?

Logic followed here is,

7 × 2 - 1 = 13

13 × 2 + 1 = 27

27 × 2 - 1 = 53

53 × 2 + 1 = 107

107 × 2 - 1 =** 213.**

Hence the correct answer is **Option 2.**
